e: A drone that originated from Belarusian airspace is shot down by NATO fighter jets near Kaunas.

Mindaugas Sinkevičius is sworn in as prime minister after the LSDP reaches a coalition agreement with the Union of Democrats "For Lithuania" and the Lithuanian Farmers, Greens and Christian Families Union.
Inga Ruginienė resigns as prime minister along with her cabinet after the LSDP ends its coalition agreement with Dawn of Nemunas.
Adrijus Jusas resigns as head of the State Enterprise Centre of Registers following a data leak involving more than 600,000 entries from national data registers blamed on a foreign state.
Lithuania's Lion Ceccah finishes 22nd at Eurovision 2026 in Austria with their single "Sólo quiero más".
Authorities announce the arrest of nine people involved in an international plot to assassinate two-anti Russian activists based in Lithuania.

Lithuania boycotts the opening ceremony of the 2026 Winter Paralympics in Italy in protest over Russian athletes being allowed to compete under the Russian flag after the lifting of sanctions imposed over the Russian invasion of Ukraine in 2022.
Lithuanian National Radio and Television says it will not air the opening ceremony of the upcoming 2026 Winter Paralympics, citing the participation of athletes from Russia and Belarus.
UEFA Futsal Euro 2026 in Latvia, Lithuania and Slovenia.
